versions.short: The resolution designates the week of September 20 through September 27, 2026, as Gold Star Families Remembrance Week. It honors and recognizes the sacrifices of families whose loved ones died while serving in the Armed Forces to defend freedom and protect the United States, as well as the families of veterans. It encourages people across the country to observe the week by doing acts of service and goodwill in their communities and by celebrating families who lost a loved one in service.
